servinfo.title: Front Brake Pad Removal and Installation

attention4.ptxt: Failure to take proper precautions during front brake caliper removal may cause damage to the front brake flexible hose and/or the brake piston.

item.ptxt: Be careful not to damage the front brake flexible hose during front brake pad removal.
Avoid depressing the brake pedal during the front brake pad removal procedure to prevent the brake piston from being forced out of the cylinder.
Check for leakage of brake fluid when removing front brake pads and repair front brake caliper if leakage is found.
Replace all front brake pads at the same time even if only one pad is defective.

s1.ptxt: Hoist vehicle and remove front wheel.
Remove front brake caliper pin bolts (1).
Remove front brake caliper (1) from front brake caliper carrier (2).

attention4.ptxt: If the removed front brake caliper is left hung by the front brake flexible hose (6), the front brake flexible hose may be damaged due to the tension caused by the caliper’s weight.
Hang a removed front brake caliper with a wire hook (4) or the like to relieve the front brake flexible hose of the tension.

attention3.ptxt: Pad springs with double-stick tape cannot be reused. Therefore, remove them only when necessary.
Replace pad springs with new ones if they are removed or come off.

s1.ptxt: Remove front brake pads (3) and pad springs (5) from front brake caliper carrier.
If pad springs (1) without double-stick tape are removed, install pad springs to front brake caliper carrier (2).
If pad springs installed with double-stick tape are removed, install new ones to front brake caliper carrier with double-stick tape following instructions included in supply parts.
Fit shims to front brake pads.
Install front brake pads (1) with shims to front brake caliper carrier (2) as shown in figure.

attention3.ptxt: Install inner pad at vehicle center side of caliper carrier with its wear indicator (1) positioned upside.

s1.ptxt: Install front brake caliper (2) to front brake caliper carrier (3) and tighten caliper pin bolts (1) to specified torque.
Check that brake system operates properly.
